title: Architecture team config
description: Schema for <home>/architecture.yaml and <home>/architecture.local.yaml: the decision-record keys /architecture:record-decision reads through the four layers of docs/adr/0075-resolve-plugin-settings-through-one-four-layer-cascade-and-a-bound-convention-home.md, and the verification level /architecture:improve reads from the team file only. The map-* keys stay in the topic doc <home>/architecture/README.md (plugins/architecture/reference/config.md).

adr_template.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown template /architecture:record-decision recommends when the repository has no ADR convention. A repository's own convention always wins. Default: the bundled skills/record-decision/templates/adr.md.

adr_extra_triggers.description: Extra conditions that join the ADR admission test's 'at least one' list (for example 'touches personal data'). A real alternative must still have been weighed.

adr_retirement.description: How /architecture:record-decision retires a record a new decision reverses, after the person's yes. delete: remove the file; its number is never reused. supersede: set its status to superseded by the new record. archive: move it to the ADR folder's archive folder.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the team file's committed copy on the default branch only, so a branch cannot lower it and architecture.local.yaml cannot set it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example improve); an entry beats this file's verification value.
